caseName: Missouri Pacific Railroad v. Izard County Highway Improvement District No. 1
caseNameFull: Missouri Pacific Railroad Company v. Izard County Highway Improvement District No. 1
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Arkansas.
attorneys: Mr. Edward J. White, Mr. Thomas B. Pryor and Mr. Samp Jennings for plaintiff in error., Mr. Joseph S. Utley for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Section *624237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1, 5-6.

Mr. Edward J. White, Mr. Thomas B. Pryor and Mr. Samp Jennings for plaintiff in error. Mr. Joseph S. Utley for defendant in error.
